NE555 Datasheet | Texas Instruments

NE555 Description:
The Nx555 and Sx555 devices are precision timing circuits capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation. Each timer has a trigger level equal to approximately one-third of the supply voltage and a threshold level equal to approximately two-thirds of the supply voltage.

NE555 Specifications

  • Package : SOP
  • Mount Type : Surface Mount
  • Min Voltage : 4.5V
  • Max Voltage : 16V
  • Quiescent Current : 15mA
  • High Level Output Current : -200mA
  • Low Level Output Current : 200mA
  • Frequency : 500kHz
  • Timers/Counters : 1
  • Terminals : 8
  • Operating Supply Current : 13mA
  • Max Operating Temp : 70°C
  • Min Operating Temp : 0°C
